mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 49 degrees with a waning crescent moon watching over Fireman's Park.
In city news, the Public Works department is excited to introduce a new leaf vacuum truck this season, and residents are reminded to keep brush and leaf piles separate for efficient collection.
There is plenty to do this week, starting with trivia today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
In a report from October 3, a 19-year-old man was arrested following a stolen firearm investigation conducted with help from the Cottage Grove Police Department.
Culver's of Verona will be serving up their daily treat when they open today at 10:00 AM.
